root_cause.consumer: fontan brisk/agast dependency while compiling the frozen DBoW2 submodule
root_cause.interpretation: The paper-era environment named OpenCV without a version bound. Its 2026 solve selected OpenCV 5, after the legacy compatibility header had been removed. The upstream build script continued after the failed sub-build and returned zero, so its return code is not evidence of a usable build.

stopping_rule_applied: The r1 provisioning attempt is retained and is not repaired in place. Any continuation requires a separately preregistered r2 infrastructure attempt with a new environment and checkout path; source edits remain forbidden.
